title: Find All Numbers Disappeared In An Array
description:
Given an array nums of n integers where nums[i] is in the range [1, n], return an array containing, in ascending order, all the integers in the range [1, n] that do not appear in nums.
 
## Examples

### Example 1
```text
Input: nums = [4,3,2,7,8,2,3,1]
Output: [5,6]
```
### Example 2
```text
Input: nums = [1,1]
Output: [2]
```

## Constraints

- n == nums.length
- 1 <= n <= 10^5
- 1 <= nums[i] <= n
- Follow up: Could you do it without extra space and in O(n) runtime? You may assume the returned list does not count as extra space.
